scope: As the architect narrowed it after the round cap: only the round-1 fixes, any correctness bug they introduce, and the required checks. New minors go into the architect's acceptance notes.

keyFindings.description: Round-1 finding 1 is only partly fixed. endsBeforeBranch matches only `type: "message"` branch entries. When a remote compaction's cut comes right after a custom_message entry (role `custom`, which is every Envoy delivery with triggerTurn, envoy.ts:1213) or a branch_summary entry, nothing matches. The prefix conversion then gets the list, and buildLiveProviderContext's slice (ve = convert(prefix).length) keeps one message past the cut. A custom_message after the match also never sets `later`. Confirmed by /legion/scratch/tmp/dr148b/probe.ts: a prefix [user, assistant, custom] returns the list. The docs (pi-envoy AGENTS.md:375-378, README.md:67-69, CHANGELOG.md:35-37) say a remote compaction carries no list.

The cached header `this read failed: <reason>.` ends with `..` when the reason already ends with a period (the tester saw it). This is output text an agent reads. The architect asked for it to be fixed in this PR.

acceptanceNotes: Live steering on the OpenAI Codex WebSocket path runs the context handler on the steering messages alone: the list goes out with a live steer, and the steer can wait up to 800 ms. Documented as a deviation in pi-envoy AGENTS.md; dispatch-first already rode along there on main.
A remote compaction whose kept tail is empty carries the list in both conversions, so it goes into the compaction request (consistent, no slice error).

claude-envoy refresher: when two refreshers both find a stale lock (REFRESH_LOCK_STALE_MS 30 s, session-hook.ts:257-268, :411), one can delete the other's lock, and the token command runs twice. No token file is left.
When Dispatch is off with an error, the newest cached list from any Dispatch URL stands in (session-answers.ts:387). Deliberate and documented.
